grid=[]
for r in range(29):
    if r in (9,19): grid.append([2]*20); continue
    band = 0 if r<9 else (1 if r<19 else 2)
    lr = r if band==0 else (r-10 if band==1 else r-20)
    row=[]
    for bandcol in range(3):
        if bandcol: row.append(2)
        row += tile[lr]
    grid.append(row)
print(len(grid),set(map(len,grid)))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,x)) for x in grid))
